title: Caro-Kann Defense: Exchange Variation
line: White trades in the center for a quiet game; Black's bishop gets out before the pawns close it in.

steps.text: Here White trades pawns in the center.
Take back with the pawn on c6. The two sides' pawns now match.

wrong.d8d5: The queen takes, but White's knight comes out and hits her, and White gains time.

steps.text: Bring the knight out. It watches d4 and e5.

also.g8f6: That also works. This lesson brings this knight out first.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out before the pawns close it in. It hits White's queen.
steps.after: White's queen steps away and hits the pawn on b7.

steps.text: Guard the pawn with your queen.

also.c6a5: That works too: the knight chases the queen. This lesson guards the pawn.

steps.after: The pawn on b7 is guarded, and only one of your bishops and knights is still at home.

summary: In the Exchange the pawns match and the game is quiet. Black brings the bishop out early and guards the side pawn.
